 Summary
 Man Utd 2-0 down at home to Roma through Soule strike and Malen penalty

 Watch Final Score at top of page, including commentary from the Nou Camp
 Five other matches also under way, as PSG lead Feyenoord 4-0 inside 17 minutes
 Live Reporting
 Jess Anderson, Gary Rose & Sam Drury
 Most recent Most popular get involved Get Involved published at 20:27 GMT 20:27 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Old Trafford feels mutinous. Not sure what happens if things get worse.
 Mark 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 150 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:26 GMT 20:26 GMT 
 Barcelona 1-0 Aston Villa 
 Nick Mashiter 
BBC Sport football news reporter at the Nou Camp 
 Villa are competitive and have had their chances. There was an expectation they would be able to exploit Barcelona's weakness in defence and they have found the gaps so far, even if they are still looking for the leveller. 
 52 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:26 GMT 20:26 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-2 Roma 
 This is the earliest a team have scored twice as the visiting side at Old Trafford in major European competition.
 279 98 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:25 GMT 20:25 GMT 
 Manchester United 0-2 Roma 
 Alan Shearer 
Former England striker on Amazon Prime 
 [Manchester United players] are very flaky, they are very nervous and they are all over the place at the minute.
 469 93 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Villa have had the chances' published at 20:24 GMT 20:24 GMT 
 Barcelona 1-0 Aston Villa 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on BBC Radio 5 Live at Nou Camp 
 Brilliant work from Nicolas Jackson. He picks the perfect pass into Johan Manzambi. It hits his heel. We have spoken about the chances you get at the Nou Camp and Aston Villa have had the chances.
 That was a chance to get themselves level.
 193 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Man Utd defensive disaster published at 20:24 GMT 20:24 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-2 Roma 
 Simon Stone 
BBC Sport Manchester United reporter at Old Trafford 
 Twice Diogo Dalot pushed up from the left back position.
 Twice Manchester United lost the ball. Matias Soule scored the first time he was left on his own. The second time Soule drove the ball into Ayden Heaven.
 This is atrocious from the home side.
 Chief executive Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox have both been picked out by the TV cameras in the directors box.
 The Manchester United fans are mutinous.
 488 39 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:24 GMT 20:24 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-2 Roma 
 Manchester United fans are getting annoyed now. They have tried to show their support for their side but, understandably, they are not happy with what they are seeing.
 It looks like a few things are being launched onto the pitch and Jason Wilcox is the subject of quite a few unhappy chants at the moment.
 278 26 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 PSG make it four; Inter lead published at 20:24 GMT 20:24 GMT 
 Villarreal 0-4 Paris St-Germain; Feyenoord 0-1 Inter; Atletico 0-0 Bayern 
 Villarreal have capitulated.
 Just 17 minutes on the clock and Fabian Ruiz drills in the fourth for Paris St-Germain. More shoddy defending from the hosts and it's punished ruthlessly by Luis Enrique's rampant side.
 Meanwhile, Inter Milan are a goal up at Feyenoord thanks to a superb strike from Yann Bisseck. The German defender finds himself on the edge of the box and bends a left-foot shot into the far corner.
 It's still goalless in Madrid between Atletico and Bayern. The German side have been up top but the best chance of the game came early for the Spanish team with Julian Alvarez breaking into the box and curling his shot just wide.
 58 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:22 GMT 20:22 GMT 
 Barcelona 1-0 Aston Villa 
 Alert work by Barcelona goalkeeper Joan García as he spots the danger from a quick Aston Villa attack and charges out of his box to clear ahead of Nicolas Jackson, who would have been one-on-one.
 95 39 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'An absolute disaster for Manchester United' published at 20:22 GMT 20:22 GMT 
 Manchester United 0-2 Roma 
 Alan Shearer 
Former England striker on Amazon Prime 
 I expected nothing other than the ball hitting the back of the net because of the form he is in, the confidence he is in, and the goals that he is scoring.
 An absolute disaster for Manchester United, but it's brilliant from Roma. They knew that this club and these players are under huge pressure and they are taking advantage of that.
 Image source, Reuters 
 490 78 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 20:22 GMT 20:22 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-2 Roma 
 And now tensions are spilling over.
 Bruno Fernandes and Matias Soule both go into the book after Fernandes continues play despite a Roma player being down. Soule isn't happy about it and makes his feelings known.
 The referee hadn't blown up so you play to the whistle. Fernandes was right to carry on but his reaction also earns him a yellow card.
 271 102 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 20:21 GMT 20:21 GMT 
 Barcelona 1-0 Aston Villa 
 First real chance of the night for Aston Villa as they break quickly and Nicolas Jackson's low ball into the box finds Johan Manzambi, but he scuffs his effort wide.
 151 75 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 20:21 GMT 20:21 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-2 Roma 
 It should be 3-0! 
 It's an absolute mess at the back from Manchester United and Donyell Malen can not believe he hasn't scored there.
 504 176 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'It's incredible of how much they have fallen' published at 20:20 GMT 20:20 GMT 
 Manchester United 0-2 Roma 
 Alan Shearer 
Former England striker on Amazon Prime 
 You have to put them in the bracket where they are [in danger of relegation in the Premier League].
 They have had a disastrous start, I think they are one point off third bottom. 
 There are no signs at the minute of any improvement, the manager is under huge pressure, directors are under huge pressure, it's incredible of how much they have fallen.
 920 137 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Man Utd 0-2 Roma published at 20:19 GMT 20:19 GMT 
 Donyell Malen 
 Donyell Malen puts the penalty away with ease and things are going from bad to worse here for Manchester United.
 Goodness me.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 2462 599 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:19 GMT 20:19 GMT 
 Barcelona 1-0 Aston Villa 
 This is a real test for Ian Maatsen, who is tasked with trying to keep Lamine Yamal quiet on the right flank. Almost all of Barcelona's attacks are going down that side.
 144 45 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 PENALTY - ROMA published at 20:18 GMT 20:18 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-1 Roma 
 Oh dear. This is surely a penalty for Roma. The ball comes off the arm of Ayden Heaven and the referee points for a spot-kick.
 VAR are taking a look but no doubt about this.
 1361 412 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 PSG three up early published at 20:17 GMT 20:17 GMT 
 Villarreal 0-3 Paris St-Germain 
 Image source, Getty Images Well, that escalated quickly. The two-time reigning champions are three up already!
 Villarreal had started well but they fail to deal with a corner, the ball drops to Joao Neves and he finishes from close range to put Paris St-Germain ahead.
 Three minutes later, Luis Enrique's side are gifted a second. Villarreal goalkeeper Peter Gulacsi with a poor kick out, straight to a PSG player and Maghnes Akliouche tees up Desire Doue to finish.
 PSG are done there, though, more intense pressing sees them win the ball back high up once more and Senny Mayulu slams in the third. Three goals in four minutes.
 Whistles already from the home fans.
 169 55 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:16 GMT 20:16 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 United didn't concede a goal in the opening 4 minutes. Mission accomplished.
 Gideon 
 No, they made it to the 11th minute this time, Gideon. 
 718 126 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Lose the ball, and all of a sudden how open they are' published at 20:16 GMT 20:16 GMT 
 Manchester United 0-0 Roma 
 Alan Shearer 
Former England striker on Amazon Prime 
 That's been an ongoing problem for Manchester United. Lose the ball, and all of a sudden [look] how open they are. 
 That one ball into Matías Soule, and it was just a question on whether he could get his touch right, compose himself, and get his finish away and he did it so so well.
 Image source, Getty Images
